name: Haruki Mei
source:
Haru is the "spring Grace".

She and Mitsuki go to the same school and are in parallel classes.

They are best friends and often spend time together after school.

One day, Haru's classmates forced her to perform a spirit summoning ritual at her old school, and Mitsuki went along with her.

Tireless and energetic, Haru can't stay still. She uses her excess energy playing soccer.

She makes new friends easily, but she is worried she will lose her peaceful days if someone suddenly dislikes her. So she tries to avoid conflicts in class.

Haru loves different outfits and dreams of participating in cosplay, but she is very shy. Plus, she is afraid her image as a daring sportswoman would be shattered.

[i]"When we're together, no ghosts can stop us".[/i] 

[Based on the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753200]official art-book[/url]]
